label: 실제스폰화계서검증
command: import json; s=json.load(open("ver5/assets/scenario/hero/stage02.json")); p=next(x for x in s["Party"] if x["Character"]=="huangfusong"); e=json.load(open("ver5/assets/data/equipment.json"))["Equipment"]["fire_manual"]; t=json.load(open("ver5/assets/data/traits.json"))["Traits"]; assert "fire_manual" in p["Equipment"] and "fire" in e["Traits"]; assert "fire_god" in p["Traits"] and "fire" in t["fire_god"]["Requires"]
